title: Common Issues been found in Notes (App)
body:
Dear users,

Regarding to the experience on Notes, the default app developed in the iOS system, I have found two common issues that greatly reduced the enjoyment of me as a user.

Firstly, the drawing function is horrible. I have tried using it on some simple 3-dimensional shape proposing for my mathematics learning. However, it was found that when I tried to add “Text”, it is hard to be dragged and moved to another place. 

Secondly, the “Text” function is horrible. When I tried to change the format of the “Text”, it is hard to manage, which is considered as user-unfriendly. 

In conclusion, these two common issues found makes me feel unsatisfied and disappointed. Whom it may concern is/are advised to take a serious look and coordinate with it.

选择长按操作按钮乱飞。误点操作。然后想撤销，发现上一步按钮就没了，没了，没了。我记录了那么多的背诵资料，笔记，我的3-4个月的学习心血。我以为退出当前笔记，然后应该会出现上一步按钮，还是没有。佛了，想想有没有历史保存上传记录。秒保存，秒上传，icloud同步实时，能不能给我们一个选择什么时候自动同步啊同步，是否实时同步啊，就这么给我保存到云端去了，本地也修改不了。云端也没有同步记录，历史保存记录。我三个月心血。
还有什么时候出个剪切板啊，剪切板bug也有，有时候复制了东西到备忘录里面粘贴按钮还是黑的，还要长按把粘贴给出来。佛了。倒霉倒霉倒霉。图方便，用你记东西，越记越多，哎哎哎哎。🥹🥹🥹🥹🥹🥹🥹

title: Failure to Auto save after software upgrade
body: There is always a problem for the auto save function for my Notes app. Before the update, my handwritten notes of the pdf doc cannot be saved occasionally which I still find it acceptable. However, after the software update, most of my new handwritten notes disappeared! The auto saving notice only pops up for a few times only. And sometimes the screen freezes for a few seconds. I am really annoyed after writing all my notes and at the end there is nothing saved. May I know if there is any method that I can save all the changes that I have made without losing them? Or is there any “save” button that I can click without the “help” of the auto saving function?
